games.name: Terminal 13: Not Human [HORROR]
games.desc:
✈️ Welcome to Terminal 13: Not Human

You’ve been assigned to the night shift at Terminal 13. Your job is simple: scan passports, question travelers, and decide who gets through. Keep the terminal clean. Follow every protocol. And whatever you do...
don’t let the wrong ones through.

⚠️ Contains horror elements such as disturbing visuals, tension, and loud sounds.
🎧 Headphones & max graphics recommended for full immersion.

❓ Will you finish your shifts… or be replaced before the morning flight?

❗DISCLAIMER: This game is an independent creation that's unrelated to games from any other platform, but is inspired by Shift At Midnight.
